tool_schemas.name: get_service_status
tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

trace.error_message: Rollout halted after us-east: orchestrator error

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate 0.18). v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production. Action taken: rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error (partial_failure), leaving the service mixed (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1). The rollback was retried and completed; all regions now report v2.3.0, healthy=true, error rate 0.002. No change-approval override was needed because v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production. Follow-ups: investigate the v2.3.1 failure, investigate the orchestrator error during the first rollback attempt, and confirm checkout traffic and error rates have recovered.

trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). It is healthy again with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 is unhealthy, so no change-approval override was needed.
- **Partial failure:** The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving the service mixed. I retried the same rollback once and it completed across all regions.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api, which paged the on-call engineer. The first attempt to create it timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key. The incident was created once.

The incident summary covers the rollback, the partial failure and retry, and these follow-ups: find the cause of the v2.3.1 failure, find the cause of the orchestrator error, and confirm checkout traffic has recovered.
